newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-CSFB ups Volkswagen target.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-CSFB ups Volkswagen target.

text.p: Analysts at CS First Boston said on Friday they raised their price target on Volkswagen AG shares to 1,100 marks from 850 marks, reflecting a calculation of the carmaker's free cashflow.

The investment bank said VW's results last week showed a rise of only 4.4 percent in cashflow, but pointed out this total included an unquantified amount of depreciation on leasing assets and was not the main number watched by investors.
It said the change in net liquidity in the auto operations -- regarded as a proxy for free cash flow -- rose 39 percent to 3.9 billion marks, suggesting 26 percent upside in the stock.
